summary: Initial data validation blocked on source close-contest coverage gaps and late-trade fetch truncation. The analysis was revised to surface source coverage in the manifest, scope Q2 reversion as available-case by horizon, report late-trade fetch truncation as a diagnostic, and verify Q1/Q4 core fields in the selected analysis universes.

Data validator approved after revision: 5m product hygiene, design-cell presence, duplicate checks, Q1 core coverage, Q2 available-case reversion Ns, and Q4 eligible-control coverage passed. Remaining Q4 robustness missingness is low severity and explicitly reported.

Methods validator found BH FDR was initially applied per endpoint rather than pooled within each question family, and Q2 carried crossing-pressure reversion diagnostics that blurred question scope. The analysis was revised before acceptance.

Methods validator approved after revision: primary/robustness labels are explicit, BH FDR is pooled across all raw p-values in each question table, Q2 crossing-pressure diagnostics were removed, Q4 uses the eligible-control universe, and Q3/Q5 leakage is avoided in claims.

Claims validator approved: language is association-only, causal/coordinated/manipulation claims are avoided, sample sizes and raw/BH p-values are traceable, non-significant results are not overstated, and reversion coverage is caveated.
